title: Embody exact transient-capacity and HBM K/V gather scheduling
hypothesis: A bounded RTL scheduler can replace fractional traffic accounting with exact Llama7B K/V byte-span descriptors, balanced locality-aware cluster ownership, and explicit four-corner HBM sources.

direct_comparison.primary_question: Can the 68 MiB transient-residency policy enumerate every exact K/V byte once for cluster consumption while preserving complete HBM traffic and balanced cluster ownership?
include: 32 layers and 128 canonical 1 MiB K/V tiles per layer
two resident full tiles plus one 128-token planar tail per layer
transient resident refill and direct-HBM source descriptors

remaining_abstractions: Span descriptors still require packetization and shared-mesh source routing.
Returned payload must be composed with canonical K/V ingress under end-to-end backpressure.
The external HBM controller and PHY remain outside the RTL boundary.
The transient SRAM and endpoint stores still require characterized memory macros.
